title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Robotics 2 for real-time robot #DeepMind #GeminiRobotics2 #robotics
description: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2, an AI system that enables robots to perform complex tasks like tying plastic bags and unscrewing lightbulbs with high precision. This innovation solves the challenge of manipulating objects that change shape unpredictably, requiring real-time reasoning rather than replaying memorized motions. Gemini Robotics 2 integrates two AI models: a reasoning brain that understands the scene and plans actions, and an action model that translates visual input into precise finger movements. This is the first AI controlling a full humanoid body capable of walking, crouching, reaching, and placing objects fluidly without pauses. Designed for versatility, the system works across various robot platforms, including humanoid robots, robotic arms, and Boston Dynamics’ Spot. Its reasoning model is available on Google AI Studio, marking a significant advance in robotic dexterity and application across industries. #GoogleDeepMind #GeminiRobotics2 #RoboticsAI #HumanoidRobots #BostonDynamicsSpot #ArtificialIntelligence #RobotDexterity #AIInnovation #RoboticsResearch #GoogleAIStudio #RobotManipulation #HumanoidRobotControl #RoboticsTechnology #AIInRobotics #RobotLearning
